Completion evidence by criterion:

1. Child closure: rebar list --parent 119f-63e3-34b7-4f96 returns exactly 19dd, 225a, 41e2, 58ef, 761e, 8153, 9447, and fc72. All eight report status=closed and a completion-verifier attestation.
2. Drop-point ownership: fc72 owns src/rebar/llm/criteria/ids.py; 761e owns batch_runner.py and gate_dispatch.py; 58ef owns workflow_ops.py; 8153 owns eval_solver.py and eval.py; 41e2 owns _llm_eval_commands.py. These seam production files are disjoint; only the intentionally shared test_code_review_project_criteria.py overlaps.
3. No-overlay parity: rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k "resolver or fan_in or parity or routing" passed with 13 passed, 15 deselected on current origin/main 975828ccb0630aebf3d045ce75f607bec14a8d0b.
4. Runtime execution and identity: tests test_project_criterion_fan_in_runs_in_round_a_with_logical_attribution, test_project_criterion_logical_attribution_is_present_once, and test_project_routing_controls_pass3_blocking cover the local seam. Live PS3 artifact fe91-f579-710f-4e48 records coverage.llm_ran=true, reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], and effective threshold/posture.
5. Eval/CLI/corpus: child 8153 covers eval_solver.py and eval.py; child 41e2 covers _llm_eval_commands.py; child 225a delivers .rebar/evals/code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries.eval.yaml, its prompt, routing, and balanced corpus. Their completion attestations are present.
6. Documentation: closed child 19dd delivers docs/llm-framework.md and has a signed completion PASS.
7. Dogfood: child 9447 is closed with completion-verifier PASS. Gerrit change 986 merged as b96d53273e3f5927dc1a7039485e7c5373ff7ac8 after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 run 30331301929, and zero unresolved comments. Clean artifact dbd9-f01b-67db-4150 has coverage.llm_ran=true with no project phase-boundary finding; the FIRE directive is absent; routing remains block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.
8. Supersession: this epic has supersedes edges to jira-reb-1001, 2c14-fa5f-1228-4e02, and 8a4b-e8b6-1bf9-48d8; direct reads report all three closed.
